conventions.impulse_vs_force: the exchange quantity q_jn is an IMPULSE per tick (N*s at the frozen tick_dt_s 0.005 s); the applied transfer and the ledger bookings are per-window impulse books (N*s), the G04 seam law (ledger identity m*dv == press + weld + gravity + contact + anchor, window 1e-12 N*s); the DECLARED /dt force conversion (60 N = 0.3/0.005) is a derived view, never a second book
conventions.predicate_literals: literals inside predicate expressions are dimensionless constants compared in the declared unit of the quantity
conventions.contract_to_graph_mapping: the frozen mathspec class carries ONE exchange quantity per two-member connection, so the contract's PRIMARY transferred quantity jn is the graph exchange record (the contract's own words: 'the connection's primary transferred quantity'); the contract's SECOND record jt is declared in declared_records below as the ground-owned derived record booked through a per-window ledger entry pair; the contract's single authoritative connection keeps ITS id conn.hand_ground_contact.v1
conventions.clocks: this spec binds the CONTRACT's frozen tick_dt_s 0.005 s (press_dt_s, M06 frozen declarations); the W03 walk-scene clock tick_hz 300 is a DIFFERENT declared fixture and is deliberately not unified (the two fixtures' clocks are declared, never averaged)

ledger_entry.sign_convention: -: the world-anchor reaction books bitwise opposite to the pad-side entry (S2 reciprocity; G04 X3 worst 0.0 N*s)

declared_records.law: LABELED EXTRA SECTION of this spec (the frozen format validator intentionally ignores unknown keys; THIS lane's harness and BOTH member modules parse and enforce it through the same closed parser spec_lang, with the frozen validator's absence of coverage declared here honestly). It carries the contract's SECOND seam record and the surface verdict law, which the ONE-exchange-per-connection class cannot carry as a second graph record

records.law: the contact tangential impulse record (contract exchanged_quantities jt, state_ownership jt owner membrane.ground.v1): the Coulomb elementwise_min pair cone at the fixture contact; the fixture carries no measured tangential tendency, so the record sits at the cone bound (the slip arm; jt <= mu_pair * jn elementwise, contract direction_sign_conventions jt); the stick arm and the sealed G04 displacement numbers (stick arrest worst 1.3877787808120304e-17 m/s; zero-mu control slides 0.05150250000055512 m under full press) belong to the sealed M06 mechanism and are NOT re-declared here

entry_sign_conventions.ground_seam.jt.into_hand_fixture: +jt_ground_y positive is the forward push-off direction in the ground frame (contract jt sign_convention, pairpath S2); the pad-side ledger books it once per tick
entry_sign_conventions.ground_seam.jt.into_ground: bitwise opposite of the pad-side jt entry (S2 reciprocity; G04 X3 window: reciprocity exact, worst 0.0 N*s)

records.window: cone window jt <= mu_pair * jn + 1e-9 every record; reciprocity exact (bitwise zero-sum); a single-side re-pin cannot raise the pair mu (packet T.GROUND_pair_rule)

records.law: the walk-surface verdict row carries TWO declared layers, exactly as F05 declares them: (1) the terrain difficulty CLASS of the true slope (F05 terrain_meta walk_core classes: water / easy_lt10deg / moderate_10_20deg / steep_20_30deg / impassable_ge30deg; thresholds declared in the ground parameters from the sealed class rules; declared vocabulary, NOT a walker qualification - TERRAIN_REPORT section 8 item 6), and (2) the WALK verdict against the declared slope envelope slope_envelope_m_per_m 0.05 m/m INCLUSIVE: outside the envelope the verdict is OUTSIDE, reported with the TRUE slope and NEVER clamped (contract valid_input_ranges slope_envelope_m_per_m outside_behavior, verbatim); water is a surface-kind row (the static sheet), not a slope row
records.verdict_rule: slope_m_per_m > slope_envelope_m_per_m -> {verdict: OUTSIDE, outside: true, class: <terrain class of the true slope>}; else {verdict: INSIDE, outside: false, class: <terrain class>}; the boundary itself (0.05 m/m exactly) is INSIDE (contract range inclusive at max 0.05); water -> {verdict: WATER, class: water}

declared_records.separation_law: when the press channel is released (press_channel_state == 0.0 exactly) the record set for the pair is empty: q_jn == 0.0 exactly, jt == 0.0 exactly, and every seam ledger entry books exactly 0.0 - support is never invented after separation (contract pair_rules separation_removes_support; the record-level analog of the sealed G04 X4 release bars and G07 accounted release)
declared_records.conserved_quantity_omitted: no conserved state functional is declared: the anchored world stores no energy and the seam closes per-window through the paired ledger entries (checked bitwise zero every window), not through a conserved scalar; the frozen format's conserved_quantity slot is therefore honestly omitted rather than filled with a decorative identity

initial_states.use: the fixture operating point fx.hand_press_impulse (armed): the press channel applies its declared per-tick impulse at the contact
the release latch's released state (fx release account): the press channel records exactly zero and the seam's support is removed

assumptions: one declared Euler step per window at the CONTRACT's frozen tick dt 0.005 s (the exchange record and every ledger booking are computed from the WINDOW-START view, zero-order hold; the record carries no cross-tick memory - the per-tick instance set has no authored existence outside the tick, contract timing per_tick_semantics)

the exchange record and both jt ledger entries derive from the ONE shared closure per connection (the compiled spec AST); every accessor agrees BITWISE every window (proven by the generated wiring's per-window one-quantity proof)

the only latching state crossing the seam is press_channel_state; its per-case value is DECLARED (armed_hold 0.3 / released 0.0) and constant over the horizon; the release latch's re-arm law is the hand side's interior and is NOT declared here
the declared state_linf_tol window below is the 1e-9 seam window of the packet (recursion windows); the seam identities themselves are checked BITWISE (exact 0.0 reciprocity, G04 X3)
numerics.declaration_note: the admissible timestep/tolerance table was declared in this spec BEFORE any run (the only admissible dt is the contract's frozen 0.005 s); the harness reads it from these bytes and may not tune it; the conserved_drift_tol row is declared for format completeness and is unused because no conserved state functional is declared (see declared_records.conserved_quantity_omitted)

analytic_reference.law: the EXACT identity reference for the fixture contact class: the jn record equals the armed press impulse (0.3 N*s) bitwise on armed ticks and exactly 0.0 on release ticks; jt == min(mu_hand, mu_surface) * jn bitwise; the walk plane stays bitwise 0.004; computed directly from the declared fixture values in the spec bytes, never reading the runtime store
